subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages

question: Should this Feishu newline candidate stay blocked until live Feishu/Lark proof is attached, or should maintainers provide or accept another proof path for this branch?
rationale: The code path looks localized after the latest fixes, but the user-visible bug depends on Feishu/Lark rendering behavior that generated payload output does not fully prove.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep this branch open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected spacing and no near-limit delivery failure.

options.title: Maintainer runs sandbox proof
options.body: If the contributor lacks tenant credentials, a maintainer can run the proof in a sandbox tenant and attach the redacted artifact before merge.

options.title: Choose a proof-positive sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer a sibling after its conflicts are resolved, designate that PR as canonical and close the remaining candidates afterward.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
